change_summary: build KataGo v1.18.2 CUDA backend + torch 2.11.0+cu128 venv under R and smoke-test a transformer net (job 297952)
expected: all five smoke steps exit 0: katago version, katago runtests, katago benchmark on a random-init transformer net, katago gtp genmove on 9x9, torch cuda forward/backward
observed: katago version OK, katago runtests OK, torch cuda forward/backward OK (device NVIDIA B200, capability (10,0), grad l2norm 11.019217); katago benchmark and katago gtp both exit 134 (SIGABRT) with "terminate called after throwing an instance of 'StringError'  what():  Non-SwiGLU transformer FFN is not yet supported in CUDA backend" (results/ktg/paper_1902.10565/evidence/env/smoke-297952-fail.txt); separately cuobjdump --list-elf on the built binary reports sm_100 count = 0 while the GPU is sm_100
root_cause: two independent defects, both visible in results/ktg/paper_1902.10565/evidence/env/smoke-297952-fail.txt: (1) the chosen smallest transformer config b5c48h3tfr uses block kind 'ffng' (gpool FFN) and cpp/neuralnet/cudaandrocmbackend.inc only implements the SwiGLU FFN variant, so the engine aborts at net load; (2) cpp/CMakeLists.txt:761 hard-sets CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES to '50 ... 90 120' for CUDA 12.8 with a plain set(), which shadows any -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES and leaves the B200 target sm_100 out of the binary
fix_hypothesis: switch the smoke model to b7c96h3tfrs, the smallest config whose block_kind is 'ffnsg' (SwiGLU), and patch the scratch clone's cpp/CMakeLists.txt 12.8 branch to '... 86 87 90 100 120' before reconfiguring and rebuilding; verify with cuobjdump --list-elf | grep -c sm_100 > 0
next_hypothesis: b7c96h3tfrs + sm_100 in the arch list makes benchmark and gtp genmove exit 0 on 9x9
